summary: Reed's, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a third amendment to its Senior Secured Loan and Security Agreement with Whitebox Advisors-affiliated lenders and Cantor Fitzgerald as administrative and collateral agent. The amendment revises the minimum liquidity covenant to a Cash/Inventory/AR Liquidity floor of $11,000,000 at all times and monthly thereafter, and replaces the equity-contribution Event of Default with a requirement for at least $2,500,000 of cash equity by November 20, 2026. A $25,000 non-refundable extension fee is due by the same date. This is a routine credit-facility amendment and private-placement funding update, not a special situation; watch the November 20 equity-funding deadline and covenant headroom.
